question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's bounded `includeFamily` selector as the public Gateway and `sessions_history` contract for reset-family transcript retrieval?
rationale: The implementation is additive and well-proven, but it creates a new public/model-facing history selector and archived-transcript visibility boundary that automation should not decide as product direction.

options.title: Accept bounded includeFamily
options.body: Approve the opt-in, bounded, header-checked family-history API in this PR and keep broader archive recovery work separate.

options.title: Revise selector contract
options.body: Ask for a different selector name, metadata shape, or pagination behavior before merge if this is not the desired durable API.

options.title: Defer history expansion
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer reset/archive recovery in a different endpoint, UI, doctor flow, or plugin surface.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded includeFamily
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in, bounded, header-checked family-history API in this PR and keep broader archive recovery work separate.
